ficha_publicada.complicacoes: Split Personality: The Creeper and Jack Ryder are two minds sharing the same body, but are often at odds with one another: the Creeper complains that Ryder holds him back, while Ryder is concerned that the Creeper might be driving him insane. Hunted: To distract those coming close to discovering the connection between Jack Ryder and the Creeper, Jack Ryder announced on his television show not only that he disapproved of vigilantes, but also offered a million dollar reward to whoever brings the Creeper to justice.
